summary: Reject symlinked or polluted snapshot and paired-checkpoint install state
details: Snapshot downloads now require real managed directories and regular partial, range-state, and artifact files, then enforce an exact release-record inventory before atomic publication or cached reuse.
Paired-checkpoint cleanup only removes real managed directories, and signed balance-history manifests must name the snapshot database with a safe basename.
Interrupted downloads and paired installs remain resumable when their durable state has the expected identity and filesystem types; suspicious entries fail closed for operator inspection.
operator_actions: If a resumed install reports a symlink, special file, or unexpected staging entry, inspect and move that entry out of the managed data root before retrying.
